label: DSINE Normals
description: DSINE single-frame surface normals (camera space). Output: raw EXR at plate size, 0-1 encoded; the node shows them decoded to -1..1.

output.tooltip: Normals are vectors, not colour: written and read as raw. DSINE's own output is 8-bit, so the half-float EXR adds no precision.

knobs.name: fov
knobs.label: fov
knobs.tooltip: Horizontal field of view of the lens in degrees (DSINE is camera-aware). Desqueeze anamorphic first.

knobs.name: iterations
knobs.label: iterations
knobs.tooltip: Refinement passes (1-20). Raise for detailed scenes.

knobs.name: resolution
knobs.label: resolution
knobs.tooltip: Processing resolution, step 64. Higher = more detail, more VRAM. The result is scaled back to plate size.
